description: This file contains database migration scripts using Alembic for schema changes, specifically altering column data types related to key length adjustments in multiple tables.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema changes to reduce VARCHAR length from 256 to 255 for specific columns in various tables.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes, restoring VARCHAR length from 255 back to 256 for the affected columns.
